name: Gaze-Hand Alignment
summary: Selection by aligning a hand-controlled pointer with the gaze ray; the target is selected when the two line up.
howItWorks: The eyes look at the target and the user moves a finger or ray into line with the gaze; alignment of the two triggers the selection without a separate click.
